Description.SourceString:
Contrary to the name, this isn’t just a great big corridor. Indeed, this is the place where the knights would gather to discuss battle tactics, hold religious debates and unleash exceedingly angry chickens upon the new recruits.

We have tried to work out what the point of the chickens was, but so far the historical documents have been annoyingly sparse on answers.
